title: Errors and crash upon clicking the duplicated items that are created via my own Godot plugin on the bottom panel.
body:
### Tested versions

Crash happens on both, the latest stable and custom built version:

v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]

v4.5.beta.custom_build [ca452113d]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Radeon RX550/550 Series (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 31.0.21923.1000) - Intel(R) Pentium(R) CPU G4400 @ 3.30GHz (2 threads)

### Issue description

[CrashDumps.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21723919/CrashDumps.zip)
[CrashDumps2.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21724034/CrashDumps2.zip)

I've also attached 2 ZIPS with Dump files and 2 .mp4 videos of the crash, albeit of lower quality but they do show crash in both stable and most importantly, in custom-built with debug symbols enabled version.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/093fb974-c17b-490c-9c69-2319aea5a4ed

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d49227a8-eb1b-4642-abb9-c9045f2582c7

Issue happens when i try to disable and re-enable my custom plugin for Godot4, which is just a simple counter for the files in both directories, **res://** _(project one)_ and **user://** _(user one)_ and click random times on the duplicated entries which my plugin creates on the bottom panel (which is a bug in my code, but it still shouldn't happen in the Godot in the first place, there should be some error handling behind to prevent that to happen.)



This is printed in the console in my custom built version with debug symbols enabled, including the backtrace -> v4.5.beta.custom_build [ca452113d]:

### Steps to reproduce

For me, as shown in the videos, the issue occurs when trying to disable and re-enable my plugin multiple times, which creates multiple entries in the bottom panel and when trying to click each one of them multiple times and then trying to click Output or something that is there by default the crash happens.
